WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.WBC) as avg_wbc,
    AVG(CAST(l.HGB AS REAL) / CAST(l.HCT AS REAL)) as avg_hgb_hct_ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_hgb_hct_ratio) as avg_ratio
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  s1.ID,
  s1.SEX,
  s1.avg_wbc,
  s1.avg_hgb_hct_ratio,
  s1.avg_hgb_hct_ratio - s2.avg_ratio as difference
FROM step1 s1
CROSS JOIN step2 s2
WHERE s2.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
  AND s1.avg_hgb_hct_ratio > s2.avg_ratio
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
